fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: fighter module creation allocates 0x80 bytes, stores vtable 0x7104f89990 and the boma, then the pointer at boma+0x168

fields.name: owner (BattleObjectModuleAccessor)
fields.evidence: constructor; offset / slot 0xc0 reach ModelModule (boma+0x78) and PostureModule (boma+0x38)

fields.name: entry_count (shake slots)
fields.evidence: setup slot 0x28 copies {count, entries} from its first argument into +0x10/+0x18; extend, stop, stop_kind, set_scale_kind, set_axis_xy_kind, offset loop i < +0x10

fields.name: entries (array of 0x90-byte shake entries)
fields.evidence: all per-kind methods walk (+0x18)+i*0x90

fields.name: shake_param_source (setup arg2)
fields.evidence: setup slot 0x28 stores its second argument; req reads it

fields.name: active_shake_count
fields.evidence: is_shake (slot 0x88) returns +0x28 > 0; req increments it; stop (slot 0x68) clears every entry then zeroes it; setup zeroes it

fields.name: offset
fields.evidence: enable_offset (slot 0x98) stores its vec3 (w=0) at +0x30 and sets +0x41; constructor zero

fields.name: model_offset_applied
fields.evidence: slot 0xc0 (apply) pushes a zero offset to ModelModule slot 0x2d8 when +0x40 is set and no shake is running; constructor zero

fields.name: offset_enabled
fields.evidence: enable_offset sets it to 1, disable_offset (slot 0xa0) to 0

fields.name: resource slot (zeroed with +0x50/+0x58)
fields.evidence: slot 0x30 (release) zeroes +0x48..+0x5f after dropping the reference held at +0x58

fields.name: shared_resource_a (ptr +0x50, control block +0x58)
fields.evidence: slot 0x30 atomically decrements the count at (+0x58)+0x8 and destroys/frees it at zero

fields.name: shared_resource_b (ptr +0x60, control block +0x68)
fields.evidence: slot 0x30 releases +0x68 the same way; req calls (+0x60)->vtable and stores into its +0x78/+0x88

fields.name: new_entry_flag (copied into entry +0x3d)
fields.evidence: req copies u8 +0x70 into the new entry's +0x3d; setup and slot 0x30 zero u16 +0x70

fields.name: ignore_slow
fields.evidence: set_ignore_slow (slot 0xb8) stores the bool; slot 0x80 (per-frame) updates entries when +0x71 or its arg is set

fields.name: entry.kind_data (hash40 at its +0x0)
fields.how: pointer; kind = (*entry+0x0) or the invalid hash 0x07fb997a80
fields.evidence: extend / stop_kind / set_scale_kind / set_axis_xy_kind find the entry whose kind hash (40 bits) equals the arg and whose +0x3e is set; stop clears it

fields.name: entry.frames
fields.evidence: extend (slot 0x60) stores its int at entry+0x30 and entry+0x58 (and 0 at +0x5c); req stores the frame count

fields.name: entry.scale
fields.evidence: set_scale_kind (slot 0xa8) stores its float at entry+0x34; req writes +0x34/+0x38

fields.name: entry.playing
fields.evidence: search loops require entry+0x3e != 0; req sets it; stop/stop_kind clear it

fields.name: entry.axis_xy
fields.evidence: set_axis_xy_kind (slot 0xb0) stores its bool at entry+0x40 of the matching kind

fields.name: entry.u54 (reset 0x7fffffff), +0x5c f32 (reset 1.0)
fields.evidence: stop/stop_kind store 0x7fffffff at +0x54 and 1.0 at +0x60 (u64 0x3f80000000000000 at +0x5c); entry+0x10 reset to a global vector; +0x78 = 0, +0x80 = invalid hash, +0x88 = 0

pointers.to: shake entries, 0x90 bytes each (kind data ptr +0x0, vec +0x10, +0x20/+0x28 copied req args, frames +0x30, scale +0x34/+0x38, flags +0x3c..+0x40, +0x54/+0x58/+0x5c timing, +0x78/+0x80/+0x88)

notes: Two classes of 128 bytes share every slot except the destructor (0x8) and offset (0x90): 0x7104f89990 (fighter; built in the fighter module-creation function, stored at boma+0x168) overrides offset with f_71006e56a0, which calls the base offset then adds a joint-based correction through ModelModule slot 0x150 and boma+0x58 slot 0x620; 0x7104f729b0 is the generic one. Exports without a dossier slot: req 0x50, req_time_scale 0x58, set_axis_xy_kind 0xb0, set_ignore_slow 0xb8. offset (slot 0x90) is computed: it sums the active entries' displacements (scaled) and adds +0x30 when offset_enabled, writing a vec3 to its argument. No exported getter is a plain load: is_shake is a comparison, so all fields are probable.
